title: 第2章 简单任务(二)
content_zh:

“老首长，哎，我真不知道该怎么说，这三个孩子都是我手下最好的兵，说实话我还真有些舍不得啊。”看着三人离去的背景少将将手中的烟头狠狠的掐灭缓缓说道。

“小王啊，我知道你的想法，可这也是没办法的事，如今Z国的黑道太猖獗了，不少黑帮组织都和国外的某些势力有关，要是在不整治的话国将不国啊。”老将军叹了口气。

“可是，可是他们就三个人啊，靠他们三个要想整和整个中国的黑道势力是不是有些太勉为其难了？他们毕竟还年轻啊，我看还不如直接派军队去灭了他们。”少将狠狠的捏了捏拳头。

老将军一副“我很失望”的表情看着少将道：“小王，这么多年了你还是没变，做什么都是这么冲动，直接灭了？你知道这会带来多重的后果吗？要真这么做了我们怎么给老百姓交代？现在各国对Z国都是虎视耽耽，这个时候不能出乱啊。”

少将皱了皱眉头，显然意识到了自己的卤莽，有些不好意思的说：“我，我这也是着急啊，他们可是我最器重的人，尤其是那个唐峰，我可把他当自己亲生儿子看的，就算不能派部队去镇压，那也要多派些人啊，就他们三个顶个屁用啊，工夫在好也架不住人多啊，百八十个拿刀的或许他们能跑掉，可要是百八十个拿枪的超人也要完蛋。”

“知道我为什么会选重他们吗？”老将军别有深意的问道。

“他们三个都不是简单人啊，尤其是那个唐峰。俗话说：三个臭皮匠顶个诸葛亮。那要是三个诸葛亮呢？他们是聪明人，你放心，我有预感，他们能成功。”老将军坚定的说道。

半个小时很快过去了，29分50秒的时候“报告”声响起在办公室的门外。

“行了，你们现在已经不是军人了，将证件，配枪交出来吧。”老将军打断三人的话说道。

三人缓缓的将自己的军官证，配枪以及肩章放到桌面上，除了唐峰外其他两人只感到鼻子发酸，他们的手始终死死的抓着自己的肩章，那是他们曾今荣誉的象征。

“好了，我们走吧。”说完后老将军率先走出门去，三人看了看少将同时敬了个军礼。

悄悄抹了抹眼泪少将装做若无其事的吼道：“真JB操蛋这房子里杂也有风呢？你们三个还站着干啥？滚，滚，滚，你们已经不是我的兵了，还赖在我这干啥？赶紧滚蛋。”说完后转过身去不愿在看三人。

待三人下楼后，少将站在窗口自语道：“你们都是老子的兵，谁要给老子丢了人看老子不废了你，哎，多好的苗子啊，上面也不知道杂想的真是浪费人材。”

4个小时后，三人随老将军及老将军的警卫员上了军用直升机。

老将军看了看三人，奇怪的问道：“唐峰，许强和关智勇前面都一副伤心欲决的样子，怎么你看上去一点反映都没有呢？”

“伤心，伤的是心而不是脸，在说也没什么好伤心的，我想通了，只要是为国家办事到那里都一样，只是我们习惯了部队生活，他们还有些不适应这么突然的离开，请您给我们一些时间，我保证我们将以最良好的状态来执行国家给我们的任务，能为国家办事是我们的光荣。”唐峰严正的答道。

“好，好样的，不亏是小王最看重的人，你们先休息一下吧，等到了BJ我在告诉你们具体任务。”老将军说完后便开始了闭目养神。

而唐峰三人此时的心情却各不相同，在唐峰看来到那里都无所谓，这么多年他习惯了战场上的撕杀，他想要的是刺激，而这次任务这么神秘，甚至到现在自己三人都不知道一丁点关于任务的事情，这使他的好胜心油然而升，况且和自己最好的两个兄弟在一起到那里他都无所谓。

许强的想法最简单，虽然对部队的一切都是那么不舍得，但是也仅仅是不舍得，只要能和峰哥在一起到那里对他来说都一样，自从妈妈走后他就没有了亲人，而峰哥和勇哥不论是在任务中还是在生活中都无微不至的关怀着他，他虽然笨，但并不傻，早在2年前和唐峰一起执行任务时唐峰为救他而中了一枪后他便认定了唐峰。

最不正常的因该算是关智勇了，他此刻在想当任务执行完后他们该去干什么？老将军的话已经说的很明显了，他们是不可能在回到部队了，可他们又能做些什么呢？自己还好说，除了手上工夫外还是个技术人材，到那里都不怕饿死，而唐峰许强两人该怎么办呢？难道要让他们像无数退伍特种兵一样因为除了战斗什么都不会而去给那些有钱人当保镖吗？不，绝对不行，他不允许自己的兄弟过这样送死你去，享福我来的生活。

想到这里，三人同时抬起头，轻轻一笑，没有一句话，所有的言语都包含在这一笑中，真正的兄弟之间并不需要过多的言语，往往只要一个眼神，一个动作便能让对方明白，接下来三只有力的手紧紧的握在一起。

天鹰，一只充满传奇的部队，与M国的超级特警队，Y国的皇家战队被称为世界最强的三支单兵作战部队，这三支部队中的每一个人都是能以一敌十的好手，普通的武警和他们比起来就好象儿童与成人的差距一般。

其中最神秘的非天鹰莫数，天鹰成立与抗战时期，最早是一个民间组织，随着全国解放，原本应该顺势解散的天鹰却被收编，并有了自己独立的番号，也就是从那时起，全世界都知道了这个部队，但却很少有人知道它的所在地。

自从它成立开始，传奇就未曾间断过，久而久之一直到现在，凡是国家解决不了或是不好解决的事情总会找他们出面，无形中这支部队扮演了国家守护者的角色。

因为对成员要求相当高，所以也注定了天鹰的人数很少，但是有一点不可否认，那就是能进天鹰的绝对都是强人。而现在，天鹰中的佼佼者带着他的两个伙伴又将会创造怎样一段传奇呢？

"Old chief, hey, I really don't know what to say. These three children are the best soldiers under my command. To be honest, I'm really reluctant to let them go." The major general in the background, who watched the three people leaving, stubbed out the cigarette butts in his hands and said slowly.

"Xiao Wang, I know what you are thinking, but there is nothing you can do about it. The underworld in Country Z is too rampant now. Many gang organizations are related to certain foreign forces. If it is not rectified, the country will not be able to do so." The old general sighed.

"But, there are only three of them. Isn't it too difficult for the three of them to consolidate the entire underworld in China? After all, they are still young. I think it is better to send the army to destroy them." The major general clenched his fist fiercely.

The old general looked at the major general with an expression of "I'm very disappointed" and said: "Xiao Wang, you haven't changed after so many years. You are always so impulsive in everything you do, and you just destroy it? Do you know the multiple consequences this will bring? How can we explain to the people if we really do this? Now all countries are looking at Country Z, and there can be no chaos at this time."

The major general frowned, obviously aware of his recklessness, and said with some embarrassment: "I, I am also anxious. They are the people I value most, especially Tang Feng. I regard him as my own son.Even if we can't send troops to suppress it, we still need to send more people. Just the three of them are useless. Even if they are good at it, they can't handle the large number of people. Maybe they can run away if they have 180 people with knives, but they will be finished if there are 180 people with guns."

"Do you know why I chose them?" the old general asked with deep meaning.

"The three of them are not simple people, especially Tang Feng. As the saying goes: Three cobblers are as good as Zhuge Liang. What if there are three Zhuge Liangs? They are smart people. Don't worry, I have a hunch that they can succeed." The old general said firmly.

Half an hour passed quickly, and at 29 minutes and 50 seconds, the "report" sounded outside the office door.

"Okay, you are no longer soldiers now. Please hand over your documents and guns." The old general interrupted the three of them.

The three of them slowly put their military ID cards, guns and epaulettes on the table. Except for Tang Feng, the other two people only felt their noses sore. Their hands were always holding on to their epaulettes, which were a symbol of their past and present honors.

"Okay, let's go." After saying that, the old general walked out of the door first. The three of them looked at the major general and saluted him at the same time.

The major general quietly wiped his tears and pretended to be nonchalant and shouted: "JB, what the hell is there wind in this house? What are the three of you still standing doing? Get out, get out, get out, you are no longer my soldiers, why are you still here? Get out of here." After saying that, he turned around and didn't want to look at the three of them.

After the three of them went downstairs, the major general stood at the window and muttered to himself: "You are all my soldiers. Whoever wants to embarrass me will see if I don't destroy you. Hey, what a good young man. The higher-ups don't know what they think. What a waste of talent."

Four hours later, the three of them boarded the military helicopter with the old general and his guards.

The old general looked at the three of them and asked strangely: "Tang Feng, Xu Qiang and Guan Zhiyong all looked heartbroken in front of them. Why don't you seem to have any reaction at all?"

"Sad, it's my heart that's hurt, not my face. There's nothing to be sad about. I've figured it out. It's the same wherever we serve the country. It's just that we are used to military life, and they are still not used to such a sudden departure. Please give us some time. I promise that we will perform the tasks assigned to us by the country in the best possible condition. It is our honor to serve the country." Tang Feng replied solemnly.

"Okay, good job. You are the person that Xiao Wang values ​​the most. You guys should take a rest first. I will tell you the specific tasks when we get to BJ." After the old general finished speaking, he began to close his eyes and rest.

Tang Feng and the other three were in different moods at this time. From Tang Feng's point of view, it didn't matter where he went. For so many years, he was used to the killings on the battlefield. What he wanted was excitement, and this mission was so mysterious that even now the three of them didn't know anything about the mission. This made him more competitive. Besides, it didn't matter where he went with his two best brothers.

Xu Qiang's idea is the simplest. Although he is so reluctant to let go of everything in the army, it is just reluctant. As long as he can be with Brother Feng, it will be the same to him. Since his mother left, he has no relatives, and Brother Feng and Brother Yong have taken care of him meticulously, both in mission and in life. Although he is stupid, he is not stupid. As early as 2 years ago, when Tang Feng was on a mission with Tang Feng, he was shot after Tang Feng was shot to save him.

The most abnormal one is Guan Zhiyong. He is thinking about what they should do after the mission is completed.The old general's words had made it obvious that it was impossible for them to return to the army, but what could they do?Fortunately, I can say that in addition to being a skilled technician, I am not afraid of starving to death wherever I go. But what should Tang Feng and Xu Qiang do?Are we going to let them work as bodyguards for rich people like countless retired special forces soldiers because they know nothing but fighting?No, absolutely not. He will not allow his brother to live a life where you will die and enjoy the life that I came to have.

Thinking of this, the three of them raised their heads at the same time and smiled softly. Without a word, all the words were contained in this smile. Real brothers do not need too many words. Often, only one look or one movement can make each other understand. Then the three strong hands held each other tightly.

The Sky Eagle, a legendary force, together with the Super SWAT Team of Country M and the Royal Troops of Country Y, are known as the three strongest individual combat units in the world. Each person in these three teams is a master who can fight one against ten. Compared with them, ordinary armed police officers are like the gap between children and adults.

The most mysterious among them is the Sky Eagle. During the establishment and the Anti-Japanese War, the Sky Eagle was originally a non-governmental organization. With the liberation of the country, the Sky Eagle, which was supposed to be disbanded, was incorporated and had its own independent designation. From then on, the whole world knew about this unit, but few people knew its location.

Since its establishment, the legend has never stopped. As time goes by, until now, they will always come to them for anything that the country cannot solve or cannot solve. Invisibly, this army has played the role of the guardian of the country.

Because the requirements for members are very high, the number of Skyhawks is destined to be very small, but one thing is undeniable, that is, those who can join Skyhawks are definitely strong people.And now, what kind of legend will the leader of the Skyhawks and his two partners create?
